Players Committee card image of [[Lightmaker (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Cancels opponent's immunity to attrition here. While at Scarif, adds 2 to attempts to 'blow away' Shield Gate.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/lightmaker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
